title: Spar says Facebook Black Friday giveaway link is a scam, Africa Check reports
date_note: The page gives no earlier day than its publication on 24 November.
geo_basis: Africa Check is based in Johannesburg; the article is about a South African retailer and does not name a victim city
summary: Africa Check reports that a link on Facebook, including in large groups, offers a Spar Black Friday giveaway through a suspicious website. Africa Check says its antivirus software flagged the link as phishing. Spar said on its official accounts that the giveaway is not an official promotion and that it would never ask customers to claim a prize through a random link.
plain: A Facebook link promising a Spar Black Friday giveaway is not real. Spar says it is not an official promotion, and Africa Check says its antivirus flagged the link as phishing.
exec: Spar says the Black Friday giveaway circulating on Facebook is not its promotion.
action: Africa Check advises checking that giveaways come from the company's official channels and avoiding third-party links; Spar says it will never ask customers to claim a prize through a random link.

validation.note: Only the AllAfrica page carrying the Africa Check article was read; it quotes Spar's statement. Africa Check's own page and Spar's accounts were not read.

review.note: action advice: official-channel advice is Africa Check's, not Spar's; action now attributes each
